origin: Authored in this repository for the X-M2 xyce grammar (task B6)
author: xdylanm
notes: The directives of X-M2 B2 to B4: analyses, sweeps, .STEP, options, initial conditions (.IC and .DCVOLT in one file, .NODESET in another, since together they abort Xyce), measurements, .DATA tables with their DATA= users, the untyped outputs and ADDRESISTORS. The solver test adds `.op` before `.END`, which gives way to each file's own analysis. A fixture whose `solver` field is {"mode": "print"} runs without -r, since Xyce aborts on -r for .EMBEDDEDSAMPLING, .HB, .LIN and .PCE. The `_crlf` file is the CRLF variant of its LF twin.
